name: shell-assistant
title: Shell Assistant
description: The floating "Ask {name}" pill at the page area's corner and the compact assistant card it opens — header actions, a removable context chip, a scrolling body and a composer slot.

meta.whenToUse: The workspace assistant on record and page screens: a corner pill that opens a small chat about what the person is looking at.
meta.whenNotToUse: The full chat page (Agents), phones (a bottom sheet composes the card's parts), or any data fetching — the host owns the chat.
